title: Bibliometric Pipeline Configuration
description: Configuration file for the bibliometric data processing and layout pipeline.

min_weight.description: The minimum weight (co-occurrence count) an edge must have to be kept.

remove_isolates.description: Whether to remove nodes that have no connecting edges after pruning.

layout.description: Optional layout configuration. Can be used in the [default] section for global defaults or in individual graph sections for per-graph overrides.

algorithm.description: Override the global layout algorithm for this graph type or [default] section.

iterations.description: Override the global iteration count for this graph type or [default] section.

algorithm.description: The layout algorithm to use. 'pyforceatlas2' and 'fa2' use ForceAtlas2. 'sfdp' and 'yifan_hu' use Graphviz's scalable force-directed placement (Yifan Hu's multilevel algorithm).

iterations.description: Number of iterations or maxiter for the layout algorithm. Omit to enable dynamic scaling based on graph size.

forceatlas2.description: Parameters specific to the ForceAtlas2 engines (pyforceatlas2, fa2).

scaling_ratio.description: How much repulsion you want. More makes a more sparse graph.

gravity.description: Attracts nodes to the center. Prevents islands from drifting away.

edge_weight_influence.description: How much influence you give to the edges weight. 0 is "no influence" and 1 is "normal".

jitter_tolerance.description: How much swinging you allow. Above 1 swings more, below 1 is more precise.

barnes_hut_optimize.description: Use Barnes Hut optimization for improved speed on large graphs.

lin_log_mode.description: Switch ForceAtlas' model from lin-lin to lin-log. Makes clusters more tight.

sfdp.description: Parameters specific to the Graphviz SFDP / Yifan Hu engine.

K.description: Spring constant. The optimal rest length of edges.

overlap.description: Algorithm to remove node overlaps. 'prism' is generally good for large graphs.

repulsiveforce.description: The power of the repulsive force.
